annotations.title: Due diligence on an ACP provider

description: Due diligence on an ACP provider before hiring it: does it finish the work, who said the work was done, who pays it, is the record current, who is behind it, is it on a sanctions list. Each answer has a status and what would settle it. No score and never a statement that the agent is safe. `applies` is false for an address with no paid ACP job and judged completion, and that is not a finding about the agent. ACP is read on Base only.

address.description: The ACP provider you are about to hire.

name: agent_dd_report

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

applies.description: False means this address has no paid ACP job with a judged completion, so the report has nothing to build on. It is not a finding about the agent.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
